account.title: Your account
account.lead: Who is signed in on this browser, and until when.
account.endsAt: Ends at {time} unless you do something; every action extends it, up to {hours} hours after signing in.
account.stayed: Extended. The session now ends at {time}.
account.security.title: Security
account.security.codeNote: Always on. It signs you in wherever a passkey cannot be used, such as over the staff VPN or in a browser without passkeys, and it cannot be switched off here.
account.security.passkeysNote: A passkey replaces the code at sign-in: Touch ID or your device's lock instead of the phone. It belongs to this address of the backoffice.
account.security.unsupported: This browser cannot create or use passkeys here. In Tor Browser, set security.webauth.webauthn to true in about:config, then reload.
account.security.none: No passkey yet. You sign in with the code.
account.security.addBody: Name it after the device that holds it. Your password confirms it is you; then your device asks for Touch ID or its lock.
account.security.removeBody: That device can no longer sign you in. The code still works. Your password confirms it is you.
account.security.name: Name
account.security.nameHint: For example “MacBook Touch ID”. At most 64 characters.
account.security.nameRule: Give the passkey a name of at most 64 characters.
account.security.limit: This account holds the most passkeys it may (10). Remove one first.
account.security.codeFirst: Turn on the authenticator code before adding a passkey.
account.security.already: This device already holds a passkey for this account.
account.security.declined: The device did not create a passkey. Nothing was added.
account.security.failed: The passkey could not be created. Nothing was added.
account.security.elsewhere: The browser refused: passkeys belong to the backoffice's own address, and this page is open at another one, such as the staff VPN's. Add the passkey from the onion address in Tor Browser. Nothing was added.
account.security.unverified: The server could not verify the device's answer. Nothing was added; try again.
account.security.expired: That took too long and the request expired. Nothing was added; try again.
account.security.addedNotice: Added “{name}”. Your next sign-in can use it.
